As a Senior Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization, indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills, able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

TGG Way Accounting Manager

Weekly

Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)

Accounting or Finance degree

Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.

Ful ly remote role with some flexibility included

Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes

Access to TGG University and learning resources

Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm

PTO after the onboarding period (most local holidays included)

This position is to join us as an Independent Contractor

Payment after 3 months will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

Loyalty

Integrity

Strong Work Ethic

Forward Thinking - Grow The Mindset

Team Player / Caring / Selfless

Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh

Freedom & Accountability

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Entry Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.


Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.


Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.


Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.


What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

Make this the place where you grow!

Você atuará em um projeto estratégico dentro de uma empresa multinacional de grande porte do setor industrial, reconhecida globalmente por sua atuação em engenharia, automação e soluções de energia.


A organização possui operações complexas e distribuídas internacionalmente, com forte foco em inovação, eficiência operacional e desenvolvimento contínuo de talentos, tornando o Learning Management System (LMS) um pilar essencial para o negócio.


Responsabilidades


  • Atuar como Consultor SAP SuccessFactors LMS em projetos de implementação e/ou sustentação
  • Levantar e analisar requisitos de negócio junto às áreas de RH e treinamento
  • Configurar e parametrizar o módulo SF Learning (LMS)
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar:
  • Currículos (Learning Paths)
  • Itens de treinamento
  • Programas de certificação
  • Garantir a execução de treinamentos obrigatórios (compliance)
  • Apoiar integrações com outros módulos do SuccessFactors (ex: Employee Central)
  • Atuar na gestão de conteúdos e plataformas de aprendizado
  • Suportar testes, validações e deploys
  • Participar de projetos globais e rollout de soluções
  • Interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com SAP SuccessFactors LMS (Learning)
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou rollout LMS
  • Conhecimento funcional e de configuração do módulo
  • Experiência com: Gestão de treinamentos corporativos; Compliance e certificações
  • Certificação em SAP SuccessFactors Learning


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes industriais ou empresas de grande porte
  • Conhecimento em integrações (EC, SSO, conteúdo externo)
  • Experiência em projetos de migração (SAP HCM → SuccessFactors)
  • Vivência com grandes volumes de usuários
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado (ambiente global)


Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT

Híbrido ou Remoto: Preferência para residentes de São Paulo, Santa Catarina e Curitiba.

*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Professor de alemão
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de alemão em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga para Professora de Alemão (REMOTO)


Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um professora de alemão qualificado e dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe de ensino online no Instituto Stephanie Lich. Se você é um profissional experiente em ensino online, organizado, atento às demandas específicas de cada aluno, e busca uma oportunidade em uma instituição que valoriza o desenvolvimento contínuo e oferece suporte constante ao professor, essa vaga é para você!


Requisitos:

  • Ser Professora : Estamos em busca de professoras para integrar o corpo docente do Instituto Stephanie Lich.


  • Disponibilidade: Ampla disponibilidade de horários, especialmente no período noturno, para atender à crescente demanda de alunos que chegam de forma orgânica por meio de nossas redes sociais, ações de marketing e parcerias.


  • Experiência e Flexibilidade: Experiência comprovada no ensino remoto de alemão e experiência e flexibilidade para utilizar diversoso materiais didáticos em sala de aula.


  • Habilidades Tecnológicas: Domínio de plataformas de ensino online, como salas de aula virtuais com lousa digital e aplicativos complementares. O pleno domínio do Google Meet é imprescindível.


  • Comunicação: Ter uma boa comunicação, tanto com os alunos quanto com a parte administrativa do Instituto.


Competências


  • Capacidade de conduzir aulas interativas e envolventes, usando diversas ferramentas tecnológicas para otimizar o aprendizado.


  • É fundamental atenção às demandas e necessidades dos alunos em prol de garantir um ensino personalizado e eficaz.


Oferecemos:

Remuneração Competitiva: Uma hora-aula de R$ 40,00 atrativa e alinhada com o mercado, comparável às demais escolas de idiomas.


Suporte ao Professor: Fornecemos todo o suporte necessário, incluindo um convênio Google para utilizações de ferramentes pagas pelo Instituto, materiais didáticos atualizados para facilitar o processo de ensino e um material didático próprio do Instituto.


Ambiente de Trabalho: Um ambiente colaborativo e de apoio, onde valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos professores e incentivamos o aprimoramento constante.


Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e, juntos, proporcionar uma experiência de aprendizado única para nossos alunos!

title: Controller de Projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Controller de Projetos em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1.Controlar a esteira de entregas dos projetos e demandas, garantindo o correto avanço dos pacotes de tarefas entre as equipes envolvidas.

2.Receber, organizar e validar as informações dos pacotes de tarefas, incluindo escopo, responsáveis, prazos, dependências e critérios de aprovação.

3.Consolidar as estimativas de horas/homem informadas pelas equipes, analisando sua coerência com o escopo e a complexidade da demanda.

4.Apoiar a composição e revisão do orçamento dos projetos, considerando alterações de escopo, esforço, prazos e impactos financeiros.

5.Controlar a aprovação dos pacotes de tarefas e liberar as atividades aprovadas para as próximas equipes da esteira.

6.Acompanhar o andamento dos projetos e pacotes de tarefas, monitorando prazos, responsáveis, pendências, gargalos e desvios.

7.Garantir que as etapas da esteira avancem somente após o cumprimento dos critérios de aprovação, documentação e aceite estabelecidos.

8.Identificar riscos, atrasos, retrabalhos, inconsistências e bloqueios, acionando as áreas responsáveis para tratativas e ajustes necessários.

9.Manter a rastreabilidade das informações, aprovações, premissas, liberações, entregas e decisões relacionadas aos projetos.

10.Consolidar relatórios gerenciais sobre status das demandas, horas previstas e realizadas, custos estimados, pacotes em andamento, pacotes concluídos e pendências.

11.Acompanhar a aderência entre horas planejadas e horas executadas, identificando variações relevantes e apoiando a análise de suas causas.

12.Apoiar as lideranças na priorização das demandas, considerando capacidade das equipes, prazos, dependências, riscos e impacto financeiro.

13.Monitorar indicadores de performance da esteira, como cumprimento de prazos, variação de horas, tempo médio por etapa, retrabalho, pacotes pendentes e demandas bloqueadas.

14.Propor melhorias nos fluxos, controles, ferramentas e critérios de passagem entre as etapas da esteira de projetos.

15.Apoiar a gestão na tomada de decisão por meio de informações confiáveis sobre esforço, custo, prazo, capacidade e andamento dos projetos.

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Entry Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.


Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.


Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.


Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.


What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Professor de alemão
description:

Vaga para Professora de Alemão (REMOTO)


Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um professora de alemão qualificado e dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe de ensino online no Instituto Stephanie Lich. Se você é um profissional experiente em ensino online, organizado, atento às demandas específicas de cada aluno, e busca uma oportunidade em uma instituição que valoriza o desenvolvimento contínuo e oferece suporte constante ao professor, essa vaga é para você!


Requisitos:

  • Ser Professora : Estamos em busca de professoras para integrar o corpo docente do Instituto Stephanie Lich.


  • Disponibilidade: Ampla disponibilidade de horários, especialmente no período noturno, para atender à crescente demanda de alunos que chegam de forma orgânica por meio de nossas redes sociais, ações de marketing e parcerias.

Remuneração Competitiva: Uma hora-aula de R$ 40,00 atrativa e alinhada com o mercado, comparável às demais escolas de idiomas.

Ideal Candidate

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients


About U S

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.


Responsibilities

Weekly

•Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collection issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to the Controller for review and payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the StaffAccountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in the financial package

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts, graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review the new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports, including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to the Staff Accountant


Requirements

4+ years of accounting experience

Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S.GAAP

Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations

Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)

Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)

Fluent English (written and spoken)

Accounting or Finance degree

Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment

Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.

Can work US Timezone schedules 9 am to 5 pm EST


Benefits

Ful ly remote role with some flexibility included

Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes

Access to TGG University and learning resources

Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm

PTO after the onboarding period (most local holidays included)


Notes:

This position is to join us as an Independent Contractor

Payment after 3 months will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave


About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.


Our Core Values:

Loyalty

Integrity

Strong Work Ethic

Forward Thinking - Grow The Mindset

Team Player / Caring / Selfless

Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh

Freedom & Accountability

title: Controller de Projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Controller de Projetos em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1.Controlar a esteira de entregas dos projetos e demandas, garantindo o correto avanço dos pacotes de tarefas entre as equipes envolvidas.

2.Receber, organizar e validar as informações dos pacotes de tarefas, incluindo escopo, responsáveis, prazos, dependências e critérios de aprovação.

3.Consolidar as estimativas de horas/homem informadas pelas equipes, analisando sua coerência com o escopo e a complexidade da demanda.

4.Apoiar a composição e revisão do orçamento dos projetos, considerando alterações de escopo, esforço, prazos e impactos financeiros.

5.Controlar a aprovação dos pacotes de tarefas e liberar as atividades aprovadas para as próximas equipes da esteira.

6.Acompanhar o andamento dos projetos e pacotes de tarefas, monitorando prazos, responsáveis, pendências, gargalos e desvios.

7.Garantir que as etapas da esteira avancem somente após o cumprimento dos critérios de aprovação, documentação e aceite estabelecidos.

8.Identificar riscos, atrasos, retrabalhos, inconsistências e bloqueios, acionando as áreas responsáveis para tratativas e ajustes necessários.

9.Manter a rastreabilidade das informações, aprovações, premissas, liberações, entregas e decisões relacionadas aos projetos.

10.Consolidar relatórios gerenciais sobre status das demandas, horas previstas e realizadas, custos estimados, pacotes em andamento, pacotes concluídos e pendências.

11.Acompanhar a aderência entre horas planejadas e horas executadas, identificando variações relevantes e apoiando a análise de suas causas.

12.Apoiar as lideranças na priorização das demandas, considerando capacidade das equipes, prazos, dependências, riscos e impacto financeiro.

13.Monitorar indicadores de performance da esteira, como cumprimento de prazos, variação de horas, tempo médio por etapa, retrabalho, pacotes pendentes e demandas bloqueadas.

14.Propor melhorias nos fluxos, controles, ferramentas e critérios de passagem entre as etapas da esteira de projetos.

15.Apoiar a gestão na tomada de decisão por meio de informações confiáveis sobre esforço, custo, prazo, capacidade e andamento dos projetos.

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Entry Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.


Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.


Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.


Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.


What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Controller de Projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Controller de Projetos em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1.Controlar a esteira de entregas dos projetos e demandas, garantindo o correto avanço dos pacotes de tarefas entre as equipes envolvidas.

2.Receber, organizar e validar as informações dos pacotes de tarefas, incluindo escopo, responsáveis, prazos, dependências e critérios de aprovação.

3.Consolidar as estimativas de horas/homem informadas pelas equipes, analisando sua coerência com o escopo e a complexidade da demanda.

4.Apoiar a composição e revisão do orçamento dos projetos, considerando alterações de escopo, esforço, prazos e impactos financeiros.

5.Controlar a aprovação dos pacotes de tarefas e liberar as atividades aprovadas para as próximas equipes da esteira.

6.Acompanhar o andamento dos projetos e pacotes de tarefas, monitorando prazos, responsáveis, pendências, gargalos e desvios.

7.Garantir que as etapas da esteira avancem somente após o cumprimento dos critérios de aprovação, documentação e aceite estabelecidos.

8.Identificar riscos, atrasos, retrabalhos, inconsistências e bloqueios, acionando as áreas responsáveis para tratativas e ajustes necessários.

9.Manter a rastreabilidade das informações, aprovações, premissas, liberações, entregas e decisões relacionadas aos projetos.

10.Consolidar relatórios gerenciais sobre status das demandas, horas previstas e realizadas, custos estimados, pacotes em andamento, pacotes concluídos e pendências.

11.Acompanhar a aderência entre horas planejadas e horas executadas, identificando variações relevantes e apoiando a análise de suas causas.

12.Apoiar as lideranças na priorização das demandas, considerando capacidade das equipes, prazos, dependências, riscos e impacto financeiro.

13.Monitorar indicadores de performance da esteira, como cumprimento de prazos, variação de horas, tempo médio por etapa, retrabalho, pacotes pendentes e demandas bloqueadas.

14.Propor melhorias nos fluxos, controles, ferramentas e critérios de passagem entre as etapas da esteira de projetos.

15.Apoiar a gestão na tomada de decisão por meio de informações confiáveis sobre esforço, custo, prazo, capacidade e andamento dos projetos.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients


About U S

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.


Responsibilities

Weekly

•Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collection issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to the Controller for review and payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the StaffAccountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in the financial package

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts, graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review the new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports, including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to the Staff Accountant


Requirements

4+ years of accounting experience

Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S.GAAP

Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations

Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)

Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)

Fluent English (written and spoken)

Accounting or Finance degree

Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment

Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.

Can work US Timezone schedules 9 am to 5 pm EST


Benefits

Ful ly remote role with some flexibility included

Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes

Access to TGG University and learning resources

Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm

PTO after the onboarding period (most local holidays included)


Notes:

This position is to join us as an Independent Contractor

Payment after 3 months will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave


About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.


Our Core Values:

Loyalty

Integrity

Strong Work Ethic

Forward Thinking - Grow The Mindset

Team Player / Caring / Selfless

Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh

Freedom & Accountability

title: Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Generative AI (LLM/VLM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Generative AI (LLM/VLM) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Generative AI (LLM/VLM)


Contract: PJ (Long-Term)

Location: Remote (100%)


Position Overview

A leading technology-driven organization is seeking a Senior Applied Scientist with deep expertise in Computer Vision, Vision Language Models (VLMs), Large Language Models (LLMs), and multimodal AI systems . This role will be responsible for designing, deploying, and optimizing advanced machine learning solutions that leverage image, text, and structured data to solve complex business challenges.

The ideal candidate combines strong research and applied machine learning experience with a proven track record of delivering scalable AI solutions in production environments. This position offers the opportunity to influence technical strategy, mentor team members, and contribute to the development of innovative AI-powered products.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, deploy, and optimize Computer Vision, VLM, and LLM solutions to address business needs.
  • Build and enhance multimodal AI models for product understanding, attribute extraction, classification, and authentication use cases.
  • Develop scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and AI-powered workflows utilizing structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Maintain clean, efficient, scalable, and production-ready code following industry best practices.
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to uncover actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Apply state-of-the-art machine learning methodologies, frameworks, and architectures to create robust AI solutions.
  • Drive technical direction and own critical components of machine learning systems throughout their lifecycle.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Business stakeholders to deliver AI-powered applications.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to the growth of organizational expertise in Computer Vision and Generative AI.
  • Support innovation initiatives through research, publications, patents, open-source contributions, and industry engagement.


Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, or Generative AI.
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production at scale.
  • Strong expertise in Computer Vision, multimodal AI systems, transformers, CNNs, foundation models, and modern deep learning architectures.
  • Hands-on experience developing, fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying LLM and/or VLM solutions.
  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and prompt engineering.
  • Advanced Python programming skills and experience with machine learning libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, and Scikit-Learn.
  • Strong data engineering and large-scale data processing experience.
  • Experience with experiment tracking, model evaluation, and automation platforms such as Weights & Biases, Ray Tune, Kubeflow, or similar tools.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related discipline.
  • Experience with multimodal foundation models and state-of-the-art Generative AI technologies.
  • Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, DSPy, or similar platforms.
  • Experience designing and maintaining MLOps pipelines for machine learning and Generative AI applications.
  • Background applying AI and machine learning techniques to real-world business challenges within retail, e-commerce, recommendation systems, visual search, product catalog management, or authentication domains.
  • Experience fine-tuning open-source foundation models and evaluating model performance, safety, robustness, and hallucination mitigation strategies.
  • Publications, patents, conference presentations, or open-source contributions related to Computer Vision, Machine Learning, LLMs, VLMs, or Generative AI.


What Makes You Successful

  • Passion for solving complex business challenges through innovative AI and machine learning solutions.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive initiatives from concept to production.
  • Ability to balance scientific rigor with practical business outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Results-oriented approach with a focus on delivering measurable business impact.
  • Commitment to building scalable, high-quality AI products and continuously improving model performance.

Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in biology, life sciences research, bioinformatics, scientific analysis, or related analytical disciplines. Applied strong knowledge of biological systems, scientific reasoning, quantitative analysis, and experimental methodologies. Utilized expertise in genetics, molecular biology, ecology, physiology, data interpretation, or simulation-based biological modeling. Evaluated scientific reasoning with exceptional attention to detail, logical consistency, and reproducible outcomes.

description:

Role Overview:

This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in tackling challenging questions and have a passion for deep mathematical reasoning and problem-solving. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Turing works with most of the leading LLM companies in the world today and your work will enable today’s leading LLMs to attain advanced mathematics proficiency.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement advanced mathematical models and computational techniques to address complex problems across diverse mathematical domains.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on research initiatives, providing mathematical expertise and analytical insights.
  • Review and engage with the latest mathematical literature, including cutting-edge research papers and emerging methodologies.
  • Apply quantitative and computational approaches to analyze data, optimize models, and support innovative problem-solving strategies.
  • Contribute to the advancement of research projects through rigorous mathematical reasoning and technical proficiency.


Desired Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics.
  • Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work.
  • Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory.
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives.


More details on required skills:

Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage:

Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic

  • Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships.

Algebra and Number Theory

  • Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications.

Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory

  • Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions.

Topology and Geometry

  • Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques.

Analysis

  • Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning.

Probability and Statistics

  • Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis.

Applied Mathematics

  • Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.

Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Engineer (Java) - Remote em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Senior Backend Engineer (Java) position focuses on designing and developing sophisticated, scalable backend systems using Java technologies. This role involves leading technical initiatives, mentoring junior engineers, and creating high-performance, robust solutions that address complex business challenges while implementing microservices architectures and ensuring technical excellence across the team.


Key responsibilities


- Architecting and implementing complex, scalable backend services using Java and related technologies.

- Leading technical design and implementation of enterprise-level software solutions.

- Java Ecosystem: Strong expertise in Java ecosystem and enterprise application design.

- Architecture Knowledge: Advanced understanding of software architecture and design patterns.

- Modern Frameworks: Experience with Spring Boot, microservices, and cloud platforms.

- Database Expertise: Proficiency in database design and optimization techniques.

Benefits:

title: Gestor de Tráfego Pago - Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gestor de Tráfego Pago - Sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Essa vaga é para assumir o tráfego pago de três negócios do Grupo Mobi e atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) do sócio.


Sobre o Grupo Mobi:

O Grupo Mobi é composto por três empresas com operações independentes e necessidades distintas de mídia, exigindo estratégias específicas para cada negócio.


  • Empresa 1: atua na locação de equipamentos hospitalares para atendimento domiciliar (B2C, Rio de Janeiro). É uma operação consolidada, na qual o Google Ads já representa a principal fonte de geração de leads. O foco está na otimização contínua da performance e na escalabilidade dos resultados.
  • Empresa 2: é uma distribuidora de equipamentos hospitalares voltada ao mercado B2B (São Paulo), atendendo hospitais, clínicas e laboratórios. A conta já está em operação e apresenta oportunidades claras de evolução, principalmente em qualificação de leads, estruturação de conversões offline e refinamento das campanhas.
  • Empresa 3: oferece serviços de BPO Financeiro para empresas (B2B) e terá sua operação de mídia desenvolvida do zero. O trabalho inicia pela construção da estratégia — definição de posicionamento, oferta, público-alvo e abordagem comercial — e evolui para a implementação das campanhas à medida que essas etapas forem validadas. Esse projeto faz parte do escopo desde o primeiro dia.


O desafio consiste em administrar três operações com diferentes níveis de maturidade , equilibrando otimização, crescimento e construção de novos canais de aquisição.


Suas atividades:

  • Assumir a gestão de Google Ads e Meta Ads das contas do grupo: estrutura, lances, públicos, criativos, testes A/B e otimização contínua, com foco em performance (CPL, CAC, qualificação de lead).
  • Começar por Mobiloc e Mobimed — otimizar contas que já rodam, não partir do zero.
  • Participar da construção da Fly Finance desde o início — começando pela estratégia e pelo desenho da abordagem (operação ainda não validada), evoluindo para a mídia quando estiver pronta.
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com o sócio: receber direcionamento e contexto de negócio, e devolver estratégia, leitura crítica e melhorias. Você provoca e propõe — não só executa.
  • Cuidar de tracking e atribuição (GA4, GTM, UTMs, integração com o CRM): hoje um gargalo real e uma das primeiras alavancas de resultado.
  • Estudar público, mercado e concorrência, traduzindo isso em estratégia.
  • Reportar em cadência curta e objetiva, dentro dos rituais definidos com o sócio.


O que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência em Google Ads e Meta Ads , com histórico comprovado em performance, indo além da gestão de campanhas, com capacidade de leitura de funil, entendimento de CAC e qualificação de leads.
  • Experiência com público B2C e B2B , considerando que o grupo atua nesses dois modelos, incluindo operações de nicho. (o grupo tem os dois, e um deles é nicho).
  • Visão estratégica com humildade de contexto e abertura para aprendizado do cenário: autonomia para propor, testar e decidir, combinada com a consciência de que se trata de um ambiente em construção, que exige escuta ativa, observação e conhecimento de negócio antes de mudanças estruturais.
  • Capacidade de escuta e execução rápida: o que é alinhado deve ser implementado com agilidade, sem necessidade constante de repetição de orientações.
  • Fluência em IA no dia a dia: aplicação contínua de IA como ferramenta prática para acelerar análises, enriquecer criativos e automatizar rotinas, com aplicação real em performance e tomada de decisão.


Diferenciais:

  • Domínio de áreas vizinhas à mídia: landing pages, CRO, analytics, tracking/atribuição;
  • Experiência com B2B de serviços ou financeiro .
  • Repertório em SEO e canais além de Google/Meta.


Remuneração: à combinar

Tipo de contrato: PJ (priorizamos alguém focado exclusivamente no Grupo)

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Horário: De 9h às 18h (segunda a sexta-feira).

title: Content Creator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Content Creator em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Content Creator

Mini Katana is looking for full-time content creators to produce short-form videos for our social media channels.


This is not an influencer sponsorship or brand deal. You will be creating content directly for our channels as part of a growing creator team.


YouTube Channel Link:



What You'll Do

  • Create engaging short-form videos for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and Facebook
  • Film yourself on camera demonstrating products, challenges, skits, trends, and creative concepts
  • Produce content consistently on a weekly basis
  • Collaborate with our team to test new ideas and improve performance
  • Help grow one of the largest creator-led brands in the collectibles and anime space



We're Looking For People Who

  • Are comfortable on camera
  • Understand what makes short-form content perform well
  • Have experience creating content for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, or Instagram Reels
  • Can consistently produce high-quality videos
  • Are interested in pursuing content creation as a full-time career
  • A large following is not required. We care more about your ability to create engaging content than your audience size.



Nice to Have

  • Film, media, or content creation background
  • Experience editing short-form videos
  • Interest in anime, gaming, collectibles, or pop culture
  • Experience working with brands or creating UGC content



Why Join Us

  • Create content as your full-time job
  • Work directly with an established brand and large social media audience
  • Freedom to experiment with content ideas and formats



To Apply

Please send:

  • Examples of your best content
  • Links to your social media accounts
  • A brief introduction about yourself and your content creation experience
  • We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experience levels. If you know how to make engaging content and are excited about creating videos full-time, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você gosta de relacionamento com clientes, tem interesse no mercado financeiro, essa oportunidade pode ser para você.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar em Customer Success, atendendo consultores, assessores de investimento e family offices.

⚡ Importante

Essa é uma posição com contratação urgente (em até 2 semanas) você terá autonomia e protagonismo na construção da área de Customer Success.

title: Account Executive (100% remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Account Executive (100% remote) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Apply here:



About the Role

Are you a fast-moving, persuasive who thrives on winning deals and building relationships? We’re looking for an Account Executive who is proactive, confident, and driven to create opportunities, not wait for them.


This role is for someone with high urgency, strong communication skills, and a natural ability to influence, connect, and close.


You’ll be responsible for generating new business, running consultative sales conversations, and closing deals with B2B clients. This is a high-performance role where speed, consistency, and relationship-building are critical.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Proactively generate new B2B opportunities through outbound (email, LinkedIn, cold calls, etc.)
  • Qualify leads based on ICP and identify real business opportunities
  • Run discovery calls with decision-makers and uncover pain points
  • Present solutions in a persuasive, consultative way
  • Build strong relationships and move deals forward with urgency
  • Manage and maintain an active pipeline in CRM
  • Follow up consistently and keep deals progressing
  • Collaborate with SDR and marketing teams to improve pipeline quality
  • Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly targets


What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience in B2B sales
  • Strong closer mentality with a track record of hitting targets
  • Highly persuasive, confident, and comfortable leading conversations
  • High urgency and fast-paced execution mindset
  • Self-starter who takes ownership and creates momentum
  • Resilient, competitive, and results-driven
  • Strong verbal and written English
  • Experience with CRM tools and pipeline management



Apply here:

Considering that the management of job positions is entirely handled by the hiring companies, and that WiseVAs operates solely as an intermediary between the candidate and the hiring company, the submission of proposals by candidates does not guarantee employment. title: Power Electronics PCB Design Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Power Electronics PCB Design Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Power Electronics PCB Design Expert to design, evaluate, and validate power electronic circuits and PCB layouts. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in power supply design, component selection, PCB layout best practices, and design verification methodologies.


Key Responsibilties

  • Design power electronic circuits including DC-DC converters, LDOs, AC-DC power supplies, and automotive power systems.
  • Create schematics and PCB layouts using tools such as KiCad, Altium, or equivalent.
  • Select components based on electrical, thermal, and reliability requirements.
  • Perform design analysis for efficiency, ripple, thermal performance, EMI, and manufacturability.
  • Generate manufacturing deliverables including BOMs, Gerber files, and assembly data.
  • Validate designs through simulations, calculations, DRC/LVS checks, and design reviews.
  • Develop and apply verification frameworks for schematic and PCB layout quality, including specification compliance, topology validation, component derating, DFM, thermal integrity, and power integrity.


Required Skills

  • Strong understanding of power electronics fundamentals (DC-DC converters, switching regulators, LDOs, power components) .
  • Hands-on experience with schematic design and PCB layout.
  • Proficiency with PCB design tools (KiCad, Altium, or similar) .
  • Ability to interpret datasheets and validate component selection.
  • Knowledge of DRC, manufacturability, grounding, routing, and EMI best practices .


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with AC-DC power supply design and automotive electronics.
  • Familiarity with thermal analysis, power integrity, and simulation tools.
  • Experience developing hardware validation or evaluation frameworks.
  • Basic scripting experience (Python/terminal-based verification workflows).


Qualification

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in power electronics and PCB design .


Key Compentencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and design quality.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams.
  • Effective communication skills.

title: Remote Physics Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

  • Design and solve challenging Physics problems to evaluate and identify the limitations of large language models.
  • Develop clear, high-quality, step-by-step solutions with precise and well-articulated reasoning.
  • Collaborate closely with LLM researchers to align problem design with evaluation objectives, particularly in areas where models typically struggle, such as abstraction, multi-step reasoning, and symbolic manipulation.
  • Contribute to the development of new evaluation benchmarks based on Physics curricula ranging from early undergraduate concepts to advanced PhD-level topics.
  • Analyze model outputs, identify reasoning gaps, and provide insights to improve model accuracy and performance.
  • Support the advancement of AI research by combining domain expertise in Physics with analytical and problem-solving methodologies.


Requirements :

  • Analytical Skills: Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capability to evaluate complex information and identify meaningful insights.
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback, detailed annotations, and clear evaluations to support continuous improvement.
  • Creative Thinking: Strong creative and lateral thinking skills, with the ability to approach problems from multiple perspectives and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote and cross-functional environment.
  • Independence: Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while managing tasks and deadlines efficiently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Access to a reliable desktop or laptop and a stable high-speed internet connection to support remote collaboration and project work.


Preferred Qualification:

  • Candidates who have completed a Master’s, Ph.D., or Postdoctoral degree in Physics, Applied Physics, or a closely related field are eligible and strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Strong ability to analyze and solve complex Physics problems using a structured, logical, and methodical approach.
  • Ability to explain Physics concepts clearly and effectively through simplified explanations, visual representations, and strong conceptual reasoning.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Product Designer (Estagiário/Trainee)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Designer (Estagiário/Trainee) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Procuram-se mentes criativas e estruturadas.


A AutoU e o que buscamos

  • A AutoU é uma empresa de IA em alto crescimento que desenvolve soluções digitais sob medida para grandes empresas.
  • Nossos clientes incluem Stellantis, Volkswagen, Nestlé, B3, Prudential, Petrobras, Johnson & Johnson e Embraer. Já geramos mais de R$60MM em ganhos e impactamos 150.000+ pessoas em 15+ países.
  • Crescemos aproximadamente 100% ao ano desde que fundamos a empresa, ganhamos por 2 anos consecutivos o Selo Dourado do CUBO Itaú e já fomos destaque em veículos como Exame e Globo.
  • Somos 45 pessoas hoje, com meta de dobrar de receita novamente em 2026.


Sobre a vaga

  • Buscamos um Product Designer com domínio profundo de Figma, paixão por produto digital e capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em interfaces simples, intuitivas e bonitas.
  • Você vai atuar na linha de frente da AutoU, tocando projetos do zero com nossos clientes enterprise, idealizando e construindo as soluções digitais que entregamos, ao mesmo tempo em que produz protótipos, apresentações e materiais visuais que sustentam tanto a entrega aos clientes quanto a expansão e a construção da marca AutoU.
  • Mais do que entregar telas, esperamos que você ajude a elevar o nível de design da empresa como um todo, evoluindo nosso design system e construindo padrões que vão escalar com o crescimento da AutoU.
  • Buscamos perfil de designer estruturado, com pensamento de produto, não apenas estético. Pessoas que entendem que design é resolver problema de usuário e gerar resultado de negócio, não só fazer interface bonita.


Seus principais desafios (dia a dia)

  • Prototipação no Figma. Construir wireframes, fluxos e protótipos navegáveis de alta fidelidade que traduzem desafios de negócio em produtos digitais reais.
  • Entendimento de produto. Mergulhar nos processos e nas dores dos usuários dos nossos clientes para projetar interfaces que resolvem problemas reais, com foco em usabilidade e adoção.
  • Fluxos e arquitetura de informação. Estruturar jornadas completas de usuário, fluxos de navegação e arquitetura de produtos digitais complexos do zero.
  • Apresentações e materiais comerciais. Construir apresentações de altíssima qualidade, materiais visuais e protótipos navegáveis que sustentam propostas comerciais, diagnósticos e showcases com diretores e C-levels.
  • Design system da AutoU. Evoluir e manter o nosso design system, criando padrões consistentes que escalam com o crescimento da empresa e dos nossos projetos.
  • Expansão e construção da marca. Apoiar diretamente a expansão da AutoU, produzindo materiais de proposta, identidade visual de projetos e ativos que fortalecem nossa presença com clientes enterprise.


O que oferecemos

  • Bolsa-auxílio competitiva. R$1.800 a R$3.600/mês de acordo com experiência prévia e portfólio, com feedbacks e promoções constantes conforme performance.
  • Cartão benefício CAJU. R$600/mês para apoiar nos dias presenciais.
  • Bônus. Premiação extra atrelada a metas e resultados da empresa.
  • Totalpass. Acesso a milhares de academias e estúdios em todo o Brasil.
  • Day off de aniversário.
  • 1 livro por mês. Investimos no seu desenvolvimento contínuo.
  • Plano de carreira estruturado, com efetivação ao término da faculdade e crescimento acelerado conforme performance.
  • Ambiente Cubo Itaú. Trabalhar dentro do maior hub de inovação da América Latina, com networking absurdo e acesso a eventos e fundadores das maiores startups do Brasil.
  • Modelo híbrido. 2x por semana presencial na nossa sede no Cubo Itaú, Vila Olímpia.
  • Mentoria direta. Trabalhar lado a lado com os founders da AutoU e nosso time de product designers experientes, aprendendo produto, IA e construção de negócios na prática.


Requisitos essenciais

  • Disponibilidade para ir 2x/semana à nossa sede na Vila Olímpia (SP Capital), além de eventos e visitas a clientes.
  • Cursando Design, Desenho Industrial, Comunicação, Publicidade, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas em universidades de excelência (FAAP, Mackenzie, Belas Artes, ESPM, USP, Insper, PUC, dentre outras).
  • Nos últimos 1 a 2 anos de graduação, com poucas aulas durante o horário comercial e ampla disponibilidade de tempo e dedicação ao trabalho.
  • Domínio real de Figma. Capacidade de prototipar fluxos completos, criar componentes reutilizáveis e trabalhar com design systems.


➕ Outros requisitos

  • Pensamento de produto. Entendimento real de UX, usabilidade, arquitetura de informação e jornada de usuário.
  • Portfólio sólido com projetos de produto digital, idealmente B2B ou SaaS. Apenas projetos artísticos ou de design gráfico puro não atendem o perfil que buscamos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de montar apresentações de altíssima qualidade e comunicar ideias com excelência.
  • Comunicação impecável, escrita e verbal, em português. Inglês fluente é diferencial forte.
  • Interesse e aptidão genuína por tecnologia, produto digital e Inteligência Artificial.
  • (Diferencial não obrigatório) Experiência prévia em startups, consultorias de produto, agências digitais ou projetos de tecnologia.


Requisito importante

É necessário residir no estado do Rio de Janeiro e ter disponibilidade para atuação presencial duas vezes por semana no Centro.

We provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses.
