title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DevOps Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

COMO Digital Life


COMO Digital Life is a CSSF-supervised payment institution based in Luxembourg. We consolidate multi-currency accounts, payments, FX, and compliance into a single regulated platform - infrastructure that was once available only to global banks, now accessible to a broader set of organizations.

We care about doing this well. That means high reliability, genuine security, and systems built to be audited and trusted.


Role Purpose


You'll join our Technology team as the engineer who owns the infrastructure backbone of a live, regulated financial platform - one that moves real money across real borders every day.


This is a hands-on role. You'll design and maintain cloud-native environments, run Kubernetes in production, and keep CI/CD pipelines fast, safe, and repeatable. You'll work alongside backend engineers, security specialists, and product teams who care about code quality and operational rigour in equal measure.


If tuning Kubernetes resource limits or building a Grafana dashboard that actually tells a story sounds like a good use of a Friday afternoon, you'll fit in here.


What You Will Do


Infrastructure & Cloud Engineering

  • Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Bicep, or Pulumi).
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes clusters in production.
  • Implement container orchestration, service meshes, and network policies.


CI/CD & Automation

  • Own CI/CD pipelines end-to-end - from commit to production - using GitHub Actions, or similar.
  • Automate build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows. Manual steps are bugs.
  • Apply GitOps practices and maintain versioned, auditable infrastructure changes.


Monitoring & Incident Response

  • Build monitoring and alerting stacks using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK.
  • Define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets - and care about the distinction.
  • Participate in incident response, run blameless post-mortems, and turn outages into better runbooks.


Security & Compliance

  • Implement secrets management, network segmentation, vulnerability scanning, and access controls.
  • Collaborate with InfoSec to meet CSSF, PCI DSS, and data protection requirements.
  • Treat compliance as a design constraint, not overhead.


Reliability & Performance

  • Manage database operations, backup strategies, and disaster recovery.
  • Optimise resource utilisation and cloud spend.
  • Run capacity planning and load testing ahead of growth, not after.

    • Documentation

    • Maintain clear, current runbooks and infrastructure documentation. If it isn't written down, it doesn't exist.
    • Share knowledge through code reviews, pair programming, and the occasional internal tech talk.


    What We're Looking For


    Required

    • Proven experience running production infrastructure on AWS.
    • Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
    • Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tools — Terraform, Bicep, Pulumi, or equivalent.
    • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
    • Strong scripting skills in at least two of: Bash, Python, PowerShell.
    • Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tools.
    • Sound understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPNs.
    • Experience with Git and trunk-based or gitflow development workflows.
    • Fluent spoken and written English


    Nice to Have

    • Service mesh experience (Istio, Linkerd, or similar).
    • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks (OPA, Kyverno, or equivalent).
    • Database operations experience - PostgreSQL, Redis, or managed cloud databases.
    • Background in a regulated industry where reliability has real consequences.
    • Cloud certifications (AWS, CKA, or equivalent).
    • Comfort using AI-assisted tools - GitHub Copilot, Claude, or ChatOps bots - as part of a daily engineering workflow.


    How We Work

    The bar here is high - for reliability, security, and auditability - because it has to be. We invest in modern tooling and good practices: infrastructure-as-code, blameless post-mortems, and documentation written before memory fades. We move with purpose, not panic.


    You'll receive direction from senior engineers and the CTO, but you'll own your systems. We value initiative, and we welcome a well-reasoned \"there's a better way to do this.\"


    How to Apply


    Send your CV in English to with the subject line “DevOps Engineer”. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within two weeks.


    Recruitment Process

    1.   Screening call with HR (30 min) 2. Interview with CTO and Dev Team. 3. Interview with CEO

description:

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this role, you'll help build the core platform that enables power utilities to move from legacy systems to an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Strong background in React
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Required Qualifications

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.

title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-Response Ad Video Editor em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding.

You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day.

Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts.

This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements
  • Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll
  • Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions
  • Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs
  • Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do
  • Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format
  • Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing
  • Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours
  • Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates

What You Need

  • Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results)
  • Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in
  • Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native
  • Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught
  • Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography
  • Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought
  • A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly
  • Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed
  • Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)

Bonus (Not Required)

  • Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space
  • Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production
  • Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)

What You Don't Need

  • A film degree
  • A fancy reel of cinematic work
  • Experience at a big agency
  • Color grading expertise

We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.

Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.

How To Apply

There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:

  • Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before.
  • If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.
  • We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference?
  • Did the first frame stop the scroll?
  • Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO?
  • Did you deliver on time?
  • If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.


To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Owner para atuar de forma remota no Brasil, responsável por maximizar o valor dos produtos digitais, garantindo o alinhamento entre as necessidades de negócio e as soluções entregues pela equipe de desenvolvimento.

  • Comunicar de forma clara o roadmap, o status das entregas e as prioridades para todas as partes interessadas.


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou função similar em times ágeis.
  • Experiência em gestão de backlog e priorização de demandas com base em impacto de negócio.
  • Capacidade de definir requisitos e critérios de aceitação de forma estruturada e objetiva.
  • Vivência no relacionamento com stakeholders e equipes de negócio.
  • Sólido entendimento de metodologias Ágeis, especialmente Scrum.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em especificações para a equipe técnica.
  • Experiência em garantir que as soluções entregues estejam alinhadas aos requisitos de negócio.
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação, negociação e tomada de decisão.
  • Residir no Brasil e ter disponibilidade para atuar 100% remoto.


Diferenciais (opcional)

  • Certificações em Agile/Scrum (ex.: CSPO, PSPO, Scrum Master).
  • Experiência em ambientes de consultoria ou projetos com múltiplos clientes.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão ágil (Jira, Azure DevOps, Trello, etc.).

Para este fim, acolhemos candidaturas de todos os candidatos qualificados independentemente do sexo, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, crenças, idade, estado civil, deficiência ou outras características.

title: Remote Mathematics Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Expert em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled and motivated mathematicians with a strong understanding of intermediate to advanced mathematical concepts and the ability to apply these concepts creatively to complex problems. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in tackling challenging questions and have a passion for deep mathematical reasoning and problem-solving. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Turing works with most of the leading LLM companies in the world today and your work will enable today’s leading LLMs to attain advanced mathematics proficiency.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement advanced mathematical models and computational techniques to address complex problems across diverse mathematical domains.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on research initiatives, providing mathematical expertise and analytical insights.
  • Review and engage with the latest mathematical literature, including cutting-edge research papers and emerging methodologies.
  • Apply quantitative and computational approaches to analyze data, optimize models, and support innovative problem-solving strategies.
  • Contribute to the advancement of research projects through rigorous mathematical reasoning and technical proficiency.


Desired Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics.
  • Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work.
  • Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory.
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives.


More details on required skills:

Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage:

Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic

  • Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships.

Algebra and Number Theory

  • Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications.

Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory

  • Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions.

Topology and Geometry

  • Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques.

Analysis

  • Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning.

Probability and Statistics

  • Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis.

Applied Mathematics

  • Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

  • Buscamos perfil de designer estruturado, com pensamento de produto, não apenas estético. Pessoas que entendem que design é resolver problema de usuário e gerar resultado de negócio, não só fazer interface bonita.


Seus principais desafios (dia a dia)

  • Prototipação no Figma. Construir wireframes, fluxos e protótipos navegáveis de alta fidelidade que traduzem desafios de negócio em produtos digitais reais.
  • Entendimento de produto. Mergulhar nos processos e nas dores dos usuários dos nossos clientes para projetar interfaces que resolvem problemas reais, com foco em usabilidade e adoção.
  • Fluxos e arquitetura de informação. Estruturar jornadas completas de usuário, fluxos de navegação e arquitetura de produtos digitais complexos do zero.
  • Apresentações e materiais comerciais. Construir apresentações de altíssima qualidade, materiais visuais e protótipos navegáveis que sustentam propostas comerciais, diagnósticos e showcases com diretores e C-levels.
  • Design system da AutoU. Evoluir e manter o nosso design system, criando padrões consistentes que escalam com o crescimento da empresa e dos nossos projetos.
  • Expansão e construção da marca. Apoiar diretamente a expansão da AutoU, produzindo materiais de proposta, identidade visual de projetos e ativos que fortalecem nossa presença com clientes enterprise.


O que oferecemos

  • Bolsa-auxílio competitiva. R$1.800 a R$3.600/mês de acordo com experiência prévia e portfólio, com feedbacks e promoções constantes conforme performance.
  • Cartão benefício CAJU. R$600/mês para apoiar nos dias presenciais.
  • Bônus. Premiação extra atrelada a metas e resultados da empresa.
  • Totalpass. Acesso a milhares de academias e estúdios em todo o Brasil.
  • Day off de aniversário.
  • 1 livro por mês. Investimos no seu desenvolvimento contínuo.
  • Plano de carreira estruturado, com efetivação ao término da faculdade e crescimento acelerado conforme performance.
  • Ambiente Cubo Itaú. Trabalhar dentro do maior hub de inovação da América Latina, com networking absurdo e acesso a eventos e fundadores das maiores startups do Brasil.
  • Modelo híbrido. 2x por semana presencial na nossa sede no Cubo Itaú, Vila Olímpia.
  • Mentoria direta. Trabalhar lado a lado com os founders da AutoU e nosso time de product designers experientes, aprendendo produto, IA e construção de negócios na prática.


Requisitos essenciais

  • Disponibilidade para ir 2x/semana à nossa sede na Vila Olímpia (SP Capital), além de eventos e visitas a clientes.
  • Cursando Design, Desenho Industrial, Comunicação, Publicidade, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas em universidades de excelência (FAAP, Mackenzie, Belas Artes, ESPM, USP, Insper, PUC, dentre outras).
  • Nos últimos 1 a 2 anos de graduação, com poucas aulas durante o horário comercial e ampla disponibilidade de tempo e dedicação ao trabalho.
  • Domínio real de Figma. Capacidade de prototipar fluxos completos, criar componentes reutilizáveis e trabalhar com design systems.


➕ Outros requisitos

  • Pensamento de produto. Entendimento real de UX, usabilidade, arquitetura de informação e jornada de usuário.
  • Portfólio sólido com projetos de produto digital, idealmente B2B ou SaaS. Apenas projetos artísticos ou de design gráfico puro não atendem o perfil que buscamos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de montar apresentações de altíssima qualidade e comunicar ideias com excelência.
  • Comunicação impecável, escrita e verbal, em português. Inglês fluente é diferencial forte.
  • Interesse e aptidão genuína por tecnologia, produto digital e Inteligência Artificial.
  • (Diferencial não obrigatório) Experiência prévia em startups, consultorias de produto, agências digitais ou projetos de tecnologia.


Requisito importante

É necessário residir no estado do Rio de Janeiro e ter disponibilidade para atuação presencial duas vezes por semana no Centro.

Job Summary

The BT PRA Engineer is responsible for implementing and supporting BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) solutions across Operational Technology (OT). The role enables secure, controlled, and auditable remote access for internal users, scientists, engineers, and external vendors supporting regulated lab systems, manufacturing platforms, and critical infrastructure. The engineer ensures secure connectivity while maintaining compliance, system availability, and data integrity across validated environments.


Responsibilities

Design, deploy, and support BeyondTrust PRA solutions for OT and laboratory environments, enabling secure remote access to systems such as MES, LIMS, SCADA, PLC-based utilities, engineering workstations, and analytical lab instruments

Manage privileged access workflows for internal teams and third-party vendors, ensuring least-privilege access, session control, and full session recording

Integrate PRA with enterprise identity systems including Active Directory and Entra ID, along with broader PAM solutions to enforce secure authentication and authorization

Maintain secure segmentation between enterprise IT networks and OT/lab environments, ensuring compliance. Support regulatory and security requirements including GxP principles, data integrity expectations, IEC 62443, and NIST cybersecurity standards

Provide operational support and troubleshooting for remote access issues across global manufacturing and R&D sites, ensuring high availability of PRA infrastructure

Develop automation scripts (PowerShell or Python) to streamline access provisioning, reporting, and integration with SIEM platforms for monitoring and audit logging

o Support and drive Architecture decisions

o Define Standard and governance

o Influence on onboard strategy (New deployments and Adoptions)

o PRA onboard lifecycle management

o Risk assessment and exception handling

o Session monitoring / investigation support

o Incident response alignment

o Audit evidence readiness

o Risk-based access approvals

o External connectivity governance

o Automation mindset and API integrations

Hands-on experience with BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) or similar PAM solutions (e.g., CyberArk)

Strong understanding of OT in regulated industries

Experience supporting systems such as SCADA, PLCs, MES, LIMS, or industrial/analytical lab instrumentation

Knowledge of identity and access management systems including Active Directory and Entra ID

Familiarity with network segmentation, secure remote access architecture, and IT/OT boundary design

Understanding of regulatory environments including GMP, GxP, and cybersecurity frameworks such as IEC 62443 and NIST

Basic scripting skills in PowerShell or Python for automation and operational support

Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture in OT


Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to OT cybersecurity tools (e.g., Nozomi, Claroty, Dragos)

Experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk or Microsoft Sentinel

Knowledge of validated systems and audit-controlled environments

Certifications such as GICSP, CISSP, or vendor certifications in BeyondTrust or PAM technologies


Soft Skills

title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-Response Ad Video Editor em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding.

You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day.

Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts.

This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements
  • Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll
  • Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions
  • Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs
  • Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do
  • Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format
  • Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing
  • Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours
  • Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates

What You Need

  • Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results)
  • Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in
  • Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native
  • Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught
  • Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography
  • Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought
  • A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly
  • Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed
  • Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)

Bonus (Not Required)

  • Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space
  • Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production
  • Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)

What You Don't Need

  • A film degree
  • A fancy reel of cinematic work
  • Experience at a big agency
  • Color grading expertise

We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.

Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.

How To Apply

There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:

  • Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before.
  • If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.
  • We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference?
  • Did the first frame stop the scroll?
  • Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO?
  • Did you deliver on time?
  • If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.


To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

title: Product Designer (Estagiário/Trainee)
description:

Procuram-se mentes criativas e estruturadas.


A AutoU e o que buscamos

  • A AutoU é uma empresa de IA em alto crescimento que desenvolve soluções digitais sob medida para grandes empresas.
  • Nossos clientes incluem Stellantis, Volkswagen, Nestlé, B3, Prudential, Petrobras, Johnson & Johnson e Embraer. Já geramos mais de R$60MM em ganhos e impactamos 150.000+ pessoas em 15+ países.
  • Crescemos aproximadamente 100% ao ano desde que fundamos a empresa, ganhamos por 2 anos consecutivos o Selo Dourado do CUBO Itaú e já fomos destaque em veículos como Exame e Globo.
  • Somos 45 pessoas hoje, com meta de dobrar de receita novamente em 2026.


Sobre a vaga

  • Buscamos um Product Designer com domínio profundo de Figma, paixão por produto digital e capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em interfaces simples, intuitivas e bonitas.
  • Você vai atuar na linha de frente da AutoU, tocando projetos do zero com nossos clientes enterprise, idealizando e construindo as soluções digitais que entregamos, ao mesmo tempo em que produz protótipos, apresentações e materiais visuais que sustentam tanto a entrega aos clientes quanto a expansão e a construção da marca AutoU.
  • Mais do que entregar telas, esperamos que você ajude a elevar o nível de design da empresa como um todo, evoluindo nosso design system e construindo padrões que vão escalar com o crescimento da AutoU.
  • Buscamos perfil de designer estruturado, com pensamento de produto, não apenas estético. Pessoas que entendem que design é resolver problema de usuário e gerar resultado de negócio, não só fazer interface bonita.


Seus principais desafios (dia a dia)

  • Prototipação no Figma. Construir wireframes, fluxos e protótipos navegáveis de alta fidelidade que traduzem desafios de negócio em produtos digitais reais.
  • Entendimento de produto. Mergulhar nos processos e nas dores dos usuários dos nossos clientes para projetar interfaces que resolvem problemas reais, com foco em usabilidade e adoção.
  • Fluxos e arquitetura de informação. Estruturar jornadas completas de usuário, fluxos de navegação e arquitetura de produtos digitais complexos do zero.
  • Apresentações e materiais comerciais. Construir apresentações de altíssima qualidade, materiais visuais e protótipos navegáveis que sustentam propostas comerciais, diagnósticos e showcases com diretores e C-levels.
  • Design system da AutoU. Evoluir e manter o nosso design system, criando padrões consistentes que escalam com o crescimento da empresa e dos nossos projetos.
  • Expansão e construção da marca. Apoiar diretamente a expansão da AutoU, produzindo materiais de proposta, identidade visual de projetos e ativos que fortalecem nossa presença com clientes enterprise.


O que oferecemos

  • Bolsa-auxílio competitiva. R$1.800 a R$3.600/mês de acordo com experiência prévia e portfólio, com feedbacks e promoções constantes conforme performance.
  • Cartão benefício CAJU. R$600/mês para apoiar nos dias presenciais.
  • Bônus. Premiação extra atrelada a metas e resultados da empresa.
  • Totalpass. Acesso a milhares de academias e estúdios em todo o Brasil.
  • Day off de aniversário.
  • 1 livro por mês. Investimos no seu desenvolvimento contínuo.
  • Plano de carreira estruturado, com efetivação ao término da faculdade e crescimento acelerado conforme performance.
  • Ambiente Cubo Itaú. Trabalhar dentro do maior hub de inovação da América Latina, com networking absurdo e acesso a eventos e fundadores das maiores startups do Brasil.
  • Modelo híbrido. 2x por semana presencial na nossa sede no Cubo Itaú, Vila Olímpia.
  • Mentoria direta. Trabalhar lado a lado com os founders da AutoU e nosso time de product designers experientes, aprendendo produto, IA e construção de negócios na prática.


Requisitos essenciais

  • Disponibilidade para ir 2x/semana à nossa sede na Vila Olímpia (SP Capital), além de eventos e visitas a clientes.
  • Cursando Design, Desenho Industrial, Comunicação, Publicidade, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas em universidades de excelência (FAAP, Mackenzie, Belas Artes, ESPM, USP, Insper, PUC, dentre outras).
  • Nos últimos 1 a 2 anos de graduação, com poucas aulas durante o horário comercial e ampla disponibilidade de tempo e dedicação ao trabalho.
  • Domínio real de Figma. Capacidade de prototipar fluxos completos, criar componentes reutilizáveis e trabalhar com design systems.


➕ Outros requisitos

  • Pensamento de produto. Entendimento real de UX, usabilidade, arquitetura de informação e jornada de usuário.
  • Portfólio sólido com projetos de produto digital, idealmente B2B ou SaaS. Apenas projetos artísticos ou de design gráfico puro não atendem o perfil que buscamos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de montar apresentações de altíssima qualidade e comunicar ideias com excelência.
  • Comunicação impecável, escrita e verbal, em português. Inglês fluente é diferencial forte.
  • Interesse e aptidão genuína por tecnologia, produto digital e Inteligência Artificial.
  • (Diferencial não obrigatório) Experiência prévia em startups, consultorias de produto, agências digitais ou projetos de tecnologia.


Requisito importante

É necessário residir no estado do Rio de Janeiro e ter disponibilidade para atuação presencial duas vezes por semana no Centro.

title: Project Manager #1008790
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager #1008790 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?



Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Estamos em busca de um profissional em projetos de TI que deverá impulsionar a excelência na execução dos projetos, manter o controle sobre escopo, cronograma e orçamento, além de assegurar entregas de alta qualidade em todas as frentes. Esta função será responsável por supervisionar a entrega ponta a ponta de quatro novos mód ulos voltados ao suporte das capacidades de Compras (Procurement), garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio, equipes de TI e uma organização terceirizada de desenvolvimento. O candidato selecionado fará parte de um projeto global em uma empresa multinacional do setor de eletrodomést icos.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:


Gestão do Programa e Supervisão das Entregas (Program & Delivery Oversight)

  • Será responsável pela entrega geral do roadmap dos módulos do Supplier Portal (4 subprojetos), gerenciando cronograma, orçamento, escopo e acompanhamento de marcos (milestones) em nível de programa.
  • Também deverá manter controle rigoroso sobre a definição de escopo, gestão de mudanças e dependências entre projetos e sistemas, além de supervisionar o desempenho do Delivery Manager e da equipe terceirizada para garantir o cumprimento dos compromissos.


Governança e Comitês Executivos (Governance & Steering)

  • Será responsável por definir e conduzir a estrutura de governança do projeto, liderando reuniões de Comitê Executivo (SteerCo), incluindo reporte de status, gestão de riscos e escalonamentos, além dos fóruns de tomada de decisão. Também deverá fornecer visibilidade e relatórios em nível executivo, assegurando transparência sobre o andamento do programa.


Gestão de Stakeholders e Alinhamento com o Negócio (Stakeholder & Business Alignment)

  • Será responsável pelo relacionamento com stakeholders da área de Compras (Procurement) e com a liderança sênior, garantindo que os requisitos de negócio sejam claramente definidos, aprovados e priorizados.
  • Deverá promover o alinhamento entre a área de Negócios (Procurement), as equipes de TI (MDR, PLM e Integração) e a organização responsável pela entrega, atuando ainda como ponto final de escalonamento para conflitos ou ambiguidades relacionadas ao negócio.


Gestão de Riscos e Problemas (Risk & Issue Management)

  • Deverá identificar proativamente riscos e dependências em nível de programa, garantindo que sejam mitigados de forma antecipada e sistemática. Também será responsável por escalar questões críticas com recomendações claras e análise de impacto.


Controle Financeiro e Planejamento (Financial & Planning Control)

  • Será responsável pelo acompanhamento e previsão orçamentária, garantindo que as entregas permaneçam dentro dos limites financeiros aprovados. Também deverá validar a alocação de recursos em conjunto com o Delivery Manager.


Liderança e Direcionamento (Leadership & Direction)

  • Deverá fornecer direcionamento claro e definição de prioridades ao Delivery Manager, garantindo foco em resultados, cumprimento de prazos e geração de valor para o negócio. Espera-se uma atuação proativa na resolução de ambiguidades e na remoção de impedimentos para acelerar a tomada de decisões e o progresso do programa.


O que você precisa ter:


  • Inglê s - Avançado (necessário para
  • Experiência como Gerente de Projetos de TI em ambientes complexos e com múltiplas frentes de trabalho simultâneas.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis de entrega (Agile).
  • Capacidade de gerenciar equipes de desenvolvimento terceirizadas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação.
  • Forte capacidade de organização e definição de prioridades.
  • Habilidade para atuar como ponte entre as necessidades do negócio e a entrega técnica.

  • Elevada atenção aos detalhes, mantendo ao mesmo tempo uma visão estratégica e abrangente do projeto.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DevOps Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

COMO Digital Life


COMO Digital Life is a CSSF-supervised payment institution based in Luxembourg. We consolidate multi-currency accounts, payments, FX, and compliance into a single regulated platform - infrastructure that was once available only to global banks, now accessible to a broader set of organizations.

We care about doing this well. That means high reliability, genuine security, and systems built to be audited and trusted.


Role Purpose


You'll join our Technology team as the engineer who owns the infrastructure backbone of a live, regulated financial platform - one that moves real money across real borders every day.


This is a hands-on role. You'll design and maintain cloud-native environments, run Kubernetes in production, and keep CI/CD pipelines fast, safe, and repeatable. You'll work alongside backend engineers, security specialists, and product teams who care about code quality and operational rigour in equal measure.


If tuning Kubernetes resource limits or building a Grafana dashboard that actually tells a story sounds like a good use of a Friday afternoon, you'll fit in here.


What You Will Do


Infrastructure & Cloud Engineering

  • Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Bicep, or Pulumi).
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes clusters in production.
  • Implement container orchestration, service meshes, and network policies.


CI/CD & Automation

  • Own CI/CD pipelines end-to-end - from commit to production - using GitHub Actions, or similar.
  • Automate build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows. Manual steps are bugs.
  • Apply GitOps practices and maintain versioned, auditable infrastructure changes.


Monitoring & Incident Response

  • Build monitoring and alerting stacks using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK.
  • Define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets - and care about the distinction.
  • Participate in incident response, run blameless post-mortems, and turn outages into better runbooks.


Security & Compliance

  • Implement secrets management, network segmentation, vulnerability scanning, and access controls.
  • Collaborate with InfoSec to meet CSSF, PCI DSS, and data protection requirements.
  • Treat compliance as a design constraint, not overhead.


Reliability & Performance

  • Manage database operations, backup strategies, and disaster recovery.
  • Optimise resource utilisation and cloud spend.
  • Run capacity planning and load testing ahead of growth, not after.

    • Documentation

    • Maintain clear, current runbooks and infrastructure documentation. If it isn't written down, it doesn't exist.
    • Share knowledge through code reviews, pair programming, and the occasional internal tech talk.


    What We're Looking For


    Required

    • Proven experience running production infrastructure on AWS.
    • Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
    • Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tools — Terraform, Bicep, Pulumi, or equivalent.
    • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
    • Strong scripting skills in at least two of: Bash, Python, PowerShell.
    • Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tools.
    • Sound understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPNs.
    • Experience with Git and trunk-based or gitflow development workflows.
    • Fluent spoken and written English


    Nice to Have

    • Service mesh experience (Istio, Linkerd, or similar).
    • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks (OPA, Kyverno, or equivalent).
    • Database operations experience - PostgreSQL, Redis, or managed cloud databases.
    • Background in a regulated industry where reliability has real consequences.
    • Cloud certifications (AWS, CKA, or equivalent).
    • Comfort using AI-assisted tools - GitHub Copilot, Claude, or ChatOps bots - as part of a daily engineering workflow.


    How We Work

    The bar here is high - for reliability, security, and auditability - because it has to be. We invest in modern tooling and good practices: infrastructure-as-code, blameless post-mortems, and documentation written before memory fades. We move with purpose, not panic.


    You'll receive direction from senior engineers and the CTO, but you'll own your systems. We value initiative, and we welcome a well-reasoned \"there's a better way to do this.\"


    How to Apply


    Send your CV in English to with the subject line “DevOps Engineer”. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within two weeks.


    Recruitment Process

    1.   Screening call with HR (30 min) 2. Interview with CTO and Dev Team. 3. Interview with CEO

What You Will Do


Infrastructure & Cloud Engineering

  • Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Bicep, or Pulumi).
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes clusters in production.
  • Implement container orchestration, service meshes, and network policies.


CI/CD & Automation

  • Own CI/CD pipelines end-to-end - from commit to production - using GitHub Actions, or similar.
  • Automate build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows. Manual steps are bugs.
  • Apply GitOps practices and maintain versioned, auditable infrastructure changes.


Monitoring & Incident Response

  • Build monitoring and alerting stacks using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK.
  • Define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets - and care about the distinction.
  • Participate in incident response, run blameless post-mortems, and turn outages into better runbooks.


Security & Compliance

  • Implement secrets management, network segmentation, vulnerability scanning, and access controls.
  • Collaborate with InfoSec to meet CSSF, PCI DSS, and data protection requirements.
  • Treat compliance as a design constraint, not overhead.


Reliability & Performance

  • Manage database operations, backup strategies, and disaster recovery.
  • Optimise resource utilisation and cloud spend.
  • Run capacity planning and load testing ahead of growth, not after.

    • Documentation

    • Maintain clear, current runbooks and infrastructure documentation. If it isn't written down, it doesn't exist.
    • Share knowledge through code reviews, pair programming, and the occasional internal tech talk.


    What We're Looking For


    Required

    • Proven experience running production infrastructure on AWS.
    • Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
    • Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tools — Terraform, Bicep, Pulumi, or equivalent.
    • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
    • Strong scripting skills in at least two of: Bash, Python, PowerShell.
    • Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tools.
    • Sound understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPNs.
    • Experience with Git and trunk-based or gitflow development workflows.
    • Fluent spoken and written English


    Nice to Have

    • Service mesh experience (Istio, Linkerd, or similar).
    • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks (OPA, Kyverno, or equivalent).
    • Database operations experience - PostgreSQL, Redis, or managed cloud databases.
    • Background in a regulated industry where reliability has real consequences.
    • Cloud certifications (AWS, CKA, or equivalent).
    • Comfort using AI-assisted tools - GitHub Copilot, Claude, or ChatOps bots - as part of a daily engineering workflow.


    How We Work

    The bar here is high - for reliability, security, and auditability - because it has to be. We invest in modern tooling and good practices: infrastructure-as-code, blameless post-mortems, and documentation written before memory fades. We move with purpose, not panic.


    You'll receive direction from senior engineers and the CTO, but you'll own your systems. We value initiative, and we welcome a well-reasoned \"there's a better way to do this.\"


    How to Apply


    Send your CV in English to with the subject line “DevOps Engineer”. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within two weeks.


    Recruitment Process

    1.   Screening call with HR (30 min) 2. Interview with CTO and Dev Team. 3. Interview with CEO

title: Remote Physics Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Expert em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

  • Design and solve challenging Physics problems to evaluate and identify the limitations of large language models.
  • Develop clear, high-quality, step-by-step solutions with precise and well-articulated reasoning.
  • Collaborate closely with LLM researchers to align problem design with evaluation objectives, particularly in areas where models typically struggle, such as abstraction, multi-step reasoning, and symbolic manipulation.
  • Contribute to the development of new evaluation benchmarks based on Physics curricula ranging from early undergraduate concepts to advanced PhD-level topics.
  • Analyze model outputs, identify reasoning gaps, and provide insights to improve model accuracy and performance.
  • Support the advancement of AI research by combining domain expertise in Physics with analytical and problem-solving methodologies.


Requirements :

  • Analytical Skills: Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capability to evaluate complex information and identify meaningful insights.
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback, detailed annotations, and clear evaluations to support continuous improvement.
  • Creative Thinking: Strong creative and lateral thinking skills, with the ability to approach problems from multiple perspectives and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote and cross-functional environment.
  • Independence: Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while managing tasks and deadlines efficiently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Access to a reliable desktop or laptop and a stable high-speed internet connection to support remote collaboration and project work.


Preferred Qualification:

  • Candidates who have completed a Master’s, Ph.D., or Postdoctoral degree in Physics, Applied Physics, or a closely related field are eligible and strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Strong ability to analyze and solve complex Physics problems using a structured, logical, and methodical approach.
  • Ability to explain Physics concepts clearly and effectively through simplified explanations, visual representations, and strong conceptual reasoning.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Manager – Activities


About Us

At HBX Group , we are a global TravelTech ecosystem connecting and empowering businesses across the world of travel. Through data, innovation, and strong partnerships, we deliver seamless experiences and help our partners grow.

Within our Activities division, we focus on building competitive, high-quality product portfolios that meet evolving market demands. Our teams operate in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where ownership, adaptability, and collaboration are key to success.


Job Summary

As a Contract Manager , you will be responsible for managing and optimizing a portfolio of suppliers, ensuring the product remains competitive, available, and aligned with market needs.

This role combines supplier relationship management, negotiation, reporting, and operational execution , with a strong focus on performance tracking, prioritization, and continuous improvement . You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to drive revenue, maintain product quality, and unlock growth opportunities.


Job Responsibilities

Supplier & Portfolio Management

  • Manage a portfolio of Activities suppliers, ensuring product availability and competitiveness at all times.
  • Maintain and develop strong relationships with suppliers, acting as the main point of contact.
  • Ensure existing products remain optimized and aligned with market expectations.


Contracting & Negotiation

  • Negotiate commercial conditions including rates, inventory, offers, and contract terms.
  • Ensure renewal contracts are competitive and available in time to capture demand.
  • Benchmark competitors and proactively renegotiate where needed to maintain market positioning.


Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze portfolio performance through bi-weekly reports and statistics , identifying trends and opportunities.
  • Monitor KPIs and take actions to improve conversion, revenue, and product performance.
  • Provide insights and explanations on portfolio performance using data and market knowledge.


Operational Excellence

  • Manage multiple processes simultaneously, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and quality.
  • Prioritize tasks effectively based on business impact and deadlines.
  • Maintain updated product content (rates, inclusions, descriptions, availability).
  • Solve operational issues and coordinate solutions with internal teams and suppliers.


Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Sales, Operations, Revenue, Product teams).
  • Support cross-functional initiatives and ensure alignment on commercial priorities.
  • Represent HBX Group in supplier meetings and market visits.


Required Skills

  • Strong prioritization and time management , with the ability to manage multiple processes simultaneously.
  • High level of analytical thinking , comfortable working with reports, data, and performance metrics.
  • Strong commercial mindset with negotiation capabilities.
  • Excellent relationship management and communication skills .
  • High attention to detail and process discipline, with flexibility to manage changing priorities.
  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently.


Required Tech Skills

  • Intermediate Excel skills (data analysis, reporting, tracking KPIs).
  • Experience working with internal systems, contracting tools, or booking platforms .
  • Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actions.
  • Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards is a plus.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 1–3+ years of experience in contracting, sourcing, account management, or similar roles.
  • Experience in travel, tourism, or supplier management is highly preferred.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese for communication with global teams.
  • Availability to travel as part of supplier relationship management.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled and motivated mathematicians with a strong understanding of intermediate to advanced mathematical concepts and the ability to apply these concepts creatively to complex problems. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in tackling challenging questions and have a passion for deep mathematical reasoning and problem-solving. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Turing works with most of the leading LLM companies in the world today and your work will enable today’s leading LLMs to attain advanced mathematics proficiency.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement advanced mathematical models and computational techniques to address complex problems across diverse mathematical domains.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on research initiatives, providing mathematical expertise and analytical insights.
  • Review and engage with the latest mathematical literature, including cutting-edge research papers and emerging methodologies.
  • Apply quantitative and computational approaches to analyze data, optimize models, and support innovative problem-solving strategies.
  • Contribute to the advancement of research projects through rigorous mathematical reasoning and technical proficiency.


Desired Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics.
  • Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work.
  • Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory.
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives.


More details on required skills:

Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage:

Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic

  • Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships.

Algebra and Number Theory

  • Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications.

Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory

  • Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions.

Topology and Geometry

  • Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques.

Analysis

  • Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning.

Probability and Statistics

  • Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis.

Applied Mathematics

  • Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Como Platform Engineer , você será o arquiteto invisível que garante que tudo funcione de forma fluida. title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-Response Ad Video Editor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding.

You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day.

Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts.

This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements
  • Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll
  • Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions
  • Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs
  • Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do
  • Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format
  • Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing
  • Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours
  • Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates

What You Need

  • Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results)
  • Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in
  • Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native
  • Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught
  • Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography
  • Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought
  • A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly
  • Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed
  • Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)

Bonus (Not Required)

  • Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space
  • Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production
  • Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)

What You Don't Need

  • A film degree
  • A fancy reel of cinematic work
  • Experience at a big agency
  • Color grading expertise

We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.

Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.

How To Apply

There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:

  • Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before.
  • If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.
  • We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference?
  • Did the first frame stop the scroll?
  • Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO?
  • Did you deliver on time?
  • If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.


To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para #109815 Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Prezensa é uma consultoria de outsourcing de tecnologia com mais de uma década de mercado e um modelo que faz diferente: o People Tech. Somos a primeira People Tech do Brasil porque acreditamos que tecnologia de verdade só é feita por gente que se sente valorizada, desafiada e apoiada. Aqui, os profissionais atuam como copilotos, presentes nas decisões que importam, assumindo responsabilidade real do começo ao fim. Cada profissional é acompanhado, cada cliente é ouvido e cada entrega tem propósito. Pessoas são nossa força motriz, atenção na pista é inegociável e resultado é a nossa linha de chegada.


Quer sentar no banco da frente? Seu caminho é na Prezensa.


Hard Skills:

Arquitetura de microsserviços, estrutura modular e escalável baseada em serviços independentes;

Arquitetura orientada a eventos, comunicação assíncrona e desacoplada entre componentes, com foco em Event-Driven;

Arquitetura Hexagonal, separação de domínios e adaptadores para flexibilidade;

DDD, modelagem de negócio com foco em domínio, silos e bounded contexts, garantindo clareza e autonomia entre áreas funcionais;

Serviços core, borda e worker, estruturação de responsabilidades entre serviços centrais, de borda e de processamento assíncrono;

Multi-tenancy, suporte a múltiplos clientes em uma única instância de aplicação, com isolamento de dados e configuração;

MCP, orquestração de agentes e protocolos de comunicação;

Agentes, automação inteligente em processos distribuídos;

LLMs, aplicação de modelos de linguagem em soluções corporativas;

Contract-first, definição de contratos de APIs antes da implementação, garantindo consistência e interoperabilidade;

IA-first, atividades orientadas pela inteligência artificial, como planejamento de demandas, previsão e priorização;

Angular 18+, construção de interfaces modernas e escaláveis com versões acima da 18;

NET 7+, uso de versões mais recentes da plataforma para maior performance e suporte a novas funcionalidades;

ORM, abstração de persistência com mapeamento objeto-relacional;

gRPC, comunicação eficiente entre serviços distribuídos;

Filas e tópicos em Kafka, mensageria distribuída com Kafka, utilização de filas e tópicos para garantir alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e processamento em tempo real.


Soft Skills:

Trabalho em equipe;

Proatividade;

Dinamismo;

Bom relacionamento interpessoal e com cliente;

Senso de urgência;

Objetividade e clareza na exposição de ideias para o time;

Boa comunicação oral e escrita.


O que nós oferecemos:

Incentivo educacional para impulsionar seu desenvolvimento;

Descontos exclusivos em cursos e instituições renomadas (FIAP, FGV, EBAC, Impacta, Full Cycle, Conecte, Open English, Cellep e mais);

Wellhub: acesso a soluções completas de saúde e bem-estar;

Onhappy: plataforma com descontos em viagens e experiências.
