title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology.


This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.


About Ten16 Creative

Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.


We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.


About the Role

The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.


This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.


You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.


You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.


You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.


Qualifications

The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.


They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover)

Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units.

This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions.

The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact
  • Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders.
  • Retention Analysis & Insight
  • Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk.
  • Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
  • Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month.
  • Salesforce Data Quality & Governance
  • Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn.
  • Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation
  • Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.



Required Qualifications & Experience

Technical & Operational Expertise

  • Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role.
  • Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting.
  • High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs.
  • Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.

Revenue & Churn Acumen

  • Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business.
  • Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics.
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations.
  • Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

Why This Role Matters

Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue.

As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover)

Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units.

This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions.

The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact
  • Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders.
  • Retention Analysis & Insight
  • Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk.
  • Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
  • Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month.
  • Salesforce Data Quality & Governance
  • Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn.
  • Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation
  • Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.



Required Qualifications & Experience

Technical & Operational Expertise

  • Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role.
  • Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting.
  • High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs.
  • Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.

Revenue & Churn Acumen

  • Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business.
  • Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics.
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations.
  • Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

Why This Role Matters

Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue.

As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

description:

We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Global TA Manager (Contractor Role)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global TA Manager (Contractor Role) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership)

Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!)


Role Overview

We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery.

As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U.S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.


What You Will Do-

  • High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via LinkedIn, regional job boards, GitHub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing.
  • HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact.
  • Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.


The DNA We Are Looking For-

The Baseline (Hard Skills):

  • Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese.
  • Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus.
  • Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U.S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.


Core Traits (Soft Skills):

  • The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions.
  • Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.


What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face

What You Will Get:

  • Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn.
  • The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network.
  • A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.


The Challenges You Will Face:

  • 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule.
  • Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.


If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let’s talk. Apply now and let’s make a global impact together!

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover)

Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units.

This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions.

The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact
  • Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders.
  • Retention Analysis & Insight
  • Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk.
  • Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
  • Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month.
  • Salesforce Data Quality & Governance
  • Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn.
  • Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation
  • Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.



Required Qualifications & Experience

Technical & Operational Expertise

  • Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role.
  • Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting.
  • High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs.
  • Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.

Revenue & Churn Acumen

  • Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business.
  • Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics.
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations.
  • Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

Why This Role Matters

Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue.

As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

title: Tech Lead IA
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead IA em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Liderar tecnicamente a construção da plataforma de Inteligência Artificial, sendo responsável pela definição arquitetural, evolução tecnológica e governança das soluções de IA Generativa, agentes conversacionais e arquiteturas multiagentes. Garantir que a plataforma cognitiva seja escalável, resiliente, segura e capaz de automatizar e resolver grande parte das interações dos clientes com alta eficiência e qualidade.


Responsabilidades & Atribuições

Liderar tecnicamente squads de IA Generativa, agentes conversacionais e automação cognitiva.

Definir a arquitetura da plataforma de IA e ecossistema multiagentes.

Atuar na construção de agentes especialistas com capacidades de reasoning, memory e autonomy.

Definir padrões técnicos, frameworks e melhores práticas para desenvolvimento de IA.

Liderar iniciativas de RAG, vector search, orchestration e memória contextual.

Garantir escalabilidade, observabilidade, segurança e governança das soluções cognitivas.

Apoiar decisões estratégicas sobre modelos LLMs, infraestrutura e plataformas de IA.

Liderar integrações entre IA, telecom, CRM, canais digitais e sistemas corporativos.

Trabalhar na evolução contínua dos indicadores de retenção, resolução e experiência do cliente.

Conduzir POCs, avaliações técnicas e experimentações com novas tecnologias de IA.

Atuar em troubleshooting avançado e resolução de problemas críticos.

Realizar mentoring técnico, code reviews e desenvolvimento do time.

Garantir alinhamento entre tecnologia, arquitetura e objetivos de negócio.

Trabalhar junto às áreas de segurança, dados, infraestrutura e governança corporativa.


Obrigatórias / Essenciais

Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, IA, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência sólida em liderança técnica de times de engenharia.

Experiência prática com IA Generativa e arquiteturas multiagentes.

Conhecimento avançado em LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen ou similares.

Experiência com APIs de LLMs e modelos open-source.

Experiência em arquitetura distribuída, microsserviços e soluções cloud.

Conhecimento em RAG, embeddings, vector databases e memória conversacional.

Experiência com Python e ecossistema de IA.

Conhecimento em observabilidade, tracing e monitoramento de IA.

Experiência com Kubernetes, Docker e CI/CD.

Conhecimento em arquitetura orientada a eventos e mensageria.

Capacidade de liderança técnica, mentoria e tomada de decisão.

Forte visão sistêmica e alinhamento entre tecnologia e negócio.

Boa comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e executivos.

Inglês técnico e capacidade de interação com fornecedores e tecnologias globais.

title: Global TA Manager (Contractor Role)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global TA Manager (Contractor Role) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership)

Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!)


Role Overview

We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery.

As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U.S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.


What You Will Do-

  • High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via LinkedIn, regional job boards, GitHub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing.
  • HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact.
  • Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.


The DNA We Are Looking For-

The Baseline (Hard Skills):

  • Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese.
  • Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus.
  • Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U.S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.


Core Traits (Soft Skills):

  • The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions.
  • Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.


What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face

What You Will Get:

  • Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn.
  • The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network.
  • A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.


The Challenges You Will Face:

  • 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule.
  • Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.


If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let’s talk. Apply now and let’s make a global impact together!

title: Operations Manager (Product)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Manager (Product) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We’re looking for a Product Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing a point of view on specific fintech verticals and defining a cohesive long-term strategy for the company and product departments
  • Acting as the eyes and ears of the company, feeding information from the market back into company strategy and department roadmaps
  • Tracking and analysing competitive position and product performance globally
  • Helping scope and launch new verticals for the company
  • Defining initial product proposition and go-to-market strategies for new expansion markets

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • A STEM or other highly quantitative degree from a top-tier university
  • A track record of outstanding achievement in different areas
  • 3+ years of experience in a strategy consulting, investment banking/PE/VC, or fast-growing technology company in a product or strategy role
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • A focus on customer-centric designs and solutions

Nice to have

  • A track record of building successful products (ideally financial) using data, customer feedback, common sense, and/or machine learning

Compensation range

  • Krakow: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly*
  • Poland: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly*
  • Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. title: Arquiteto Cloud & DevOps Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto Cloud & DevOps Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Viva a experiência SONDA

Aqui você transforma sua carreira!



Por que fazer parte da SONDA?



Porque assim como você, amamos o que fazemos, temos paixão por inovação e estamos convencidos de que através do conhecimento e da tecnologia vamos transformar não só os negócios de nossos clientes, mas também o futuro.



Na SONDA você terá uma experiência de trabalho com diversas oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional. Um excelente lugar para aprender e contribuir para melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da tecnologia.



Procuramos Arquiteto Cloud & DevOps Sênior que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Modalidade de Trabalho: Atuação em formato 100% remoto ou presencial em Brasília (Asa Norte), São Paulo (Osasco) ou Rio de Janeiro (Centro).


Horário: Noturno ou Diurno



Nesta função você irá:

  • Projetar, implementar e sustentar arquiteturas escaláveis, resilientes e seguras em ambientes Multi-Cloud (AWS, Azure e GCP), garantindo alta disponibilidade, performance e alinhamento às melhores práticas de mercado;
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, deploy e integração contínua utilizando práticas DevOps, GitOps, CI/CD, Terraform, CloudFormation, Azure DevOps, GitHub e ArgoCD;
  • Atuar na administração e evolução da infraestrutura cloud, realizando planejamento de capacidade, otimização de recursos e suporte à transformação digital da companhia;
  • Implementar e administrar ambientes conteinerizados utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Amazon EKS e ECS;
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código (IaC), promovendo padronização, escalabilidade e automação dos ambientes;
  • Implementar soluções de monitoramento, observabilidade e troubleshooting utilizando CloudWatch, Prometheus e Grafana;
  • Atuar na identificação e resolução de incidentes críticos, realizando análises de causa raiz e garantindo estabilidade operacional dos ambientes;
  • Implementar e administrar soluções de segurança cloud, incluindo IAM, WAF, Security Groups, políticas de acesso, compliance e governança;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, realizando análise e otimização de custos dos ambientes cloud;
  • Desenvolver integrações e automações através de APIs e serviços de infraestrutura;
  • Apoiar projetos de dados e analytics utilizando serviços AWS como Glue, Redshift e Kinesis;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, segurança e operações, apoiando decisões técnicas e arquiteturais;
  • Garantir boas práticas de versionamento, workflows Git, gestão de repositórios e versionamento semântico;
  • Participar da definição de padrões arquiteturais, melhoria contínua e evolução tecnológica dos ambientes corporativos;
  • Criar e manter documentações técnicas, diagramas e padrões operacionais;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva e hands-on em ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade tecnológica.



Ideal se você tiver:

  • Formação de ensino superior cursando ou completo;
  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura, administração e sustentação de ambientes Cloud Multi-Cloud (AWS, Azure e GCP);
  • Vivência em projetos de infraestrutura cloud escalável, resiliente e segura;
  • Conhecimento avançado em DevOps, GitOps e automação de infraestrutura;
  • Experiência prática com CI/CD utilizando Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions e pipelines automatizados;
  • Forte experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform e CloudFormation;
  • Conhecimento em containers e orquestração com Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Amazon EKS e ECS;
  • Experiência em automação e integração via APIs para infraestrutura e operações;
  • Conhecimento em Linux, redes, SDN, armazenamento (SDS) e virtualização de containers;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento como CloudWatch, Prometheus e Grafana;
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e análise de incidentes em ambientes complexos;
  • Conhecimento em segurança cloud, IAM, WAF, Security Groups e boas práticas de governança;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados e serviços de dados em cloud;
  • Experiência com serviços AWS como Glue, Redshift e Kinesis;
  • Conhecimento em versionamento Git, workflows de repositórios, tags e versionamento semântico;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de automação e scripting como Python, Shell Script e JavaScript;
  • Capacidade analítica para resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para atuação colaborativa entre times multidisciplinares;
  • Perfil hands-on, proativo e orientado à melhoria contínua;
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambientes ágeis e dinâmicos.



Será considerando um diferencial:

  • Certificações AWS, como:
  • AWS Solutions Architect
  • AWS DevOps Engineer
  • AWS Security Specialist
  • Conhecimento em FinOps e otimização de custos cloud;
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a microsserviços;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de alta criticidade.



O que você pode esperar de nós?


  • Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.


O que oferecemos?


  • SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.
  • SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.
  • E muito mais!



+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração



Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.



Faça parte da nossa equipe!

Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto Cloud & DevOps Sênior em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Viva a experiência SONDA

Aqui você transforma sua carreira!



Por que fazer parte da SONDA?



Porque assim como você, amamos o que fazemos, temos paixão por inovação e estamos convencidos de que através do conhecimento e da tecnologia vamos transformar não só os negócios de nossos clientes, mas também o futuro.



Na SONDA você terá uma experiência de trabalho com diversas oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional. Um excelente lugar para aprender e contribuir para melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da tecnologia.



Procuramos Arquiteto Cloud & DevOps Sênior que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Modalidade de Trabalho: Atuação em formato 100% remoto ou presencial em Brasília (Asa Norte), São Paulo (Osasco) ou Rio de Janeiro (Centro).


Horário: Noturno ou Diurno



Nesta função você irá:

  • Projetar, implementar e sustentar arquiteturas escaláveis, resilientes e seguras em ambientes Multi-Cloud (AWS, Azure e GCP), garantindo alta disponibilidade, performance e alinhamento às melhores práticas de mercado;
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, deploy e integração contínua utilizando práticas DevOps, GitOps, CI/CD, Terraform, CloudFormation, Azure DevOps, GitHub e ArgoCD;
  • Atuar na administração e evolução da infraestrutura cloud, realizando planejamento de capacidade, otimização de recursos e suporte à transformação digital da companhia;
  • Implementar e administrar ambientes conteinerizados utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Amazon EKS e ECS;
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código (IaC), promovendo padronização, escalabilidade e automação dos ambientes;
  • Implementar soluções de monitoramento, observabilidade e troubleshooting utilizando CloudWatch, Prometheus e Grafana;
  • Atuar na identificação e resolução de incidentes críticos, realizando análises de causa raiz e garantindo estabilidade operacional dos ambientes;
  • Implementar e administrar soluções de segurança cloud, incluindo IAM, WAF, Security Groups, políticas de acesso, compliance e governança;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, realizando análise e otimização de custos dos ambientes cloud;
  • Desenvolver integrações e automações através de APIs e serviços de infraestrutura;
  • Apoiar projetos de dados e analytics utilizando serviços AWS como Glue, Redshift e Kinesis;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, segurança e operações, apoiando decisões técnicas e arquiteturais;
  • Garantir boas práticas de versionamento, workflows Git, gestão de repositórios e versionamento semântico;
  • Participar da definição de padrões arquiteturais, melhoria contínua e evolução tecnológica dos ambientes corporativos;
  • Criar e manter documentações técnicas, diagramas e padrões operacionais;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva e hands-on em ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade tecnológica.



Ideal se você tiver:

  • Formação de ensino superior cursando ou completo;
  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura, administração e sustentação de ambientes Cloud Multi-Cloud (AWS, Azure e GCP);
  • Vivência em projetos de infraestrutura cloud escalável, resiliente e segura;
  • Conhecimento avançado em DevOps, GitOps e automação de infraestrutura;
  • Experiência prática com CI/CD utilizando Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions e pipelines automatizados;
  • Forte experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform e CloudFormation;
  • Conhecimento em containers e orquestração com Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Amazon EKS e ECS;
  • Experiência em automação e integração via APIs para infraestrutura e operações;
  • Conhecimento em Linux, redes, SDN, armazenamento (SDS) e virtualização de containers;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento como CloudWatch, Prometheus e Grafana;
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e análise de incidentes em ambientes complexos;
  • Conhecimento em segurança cloud, IAM, WAF, Security Groups e boas práticas de governança;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados e serviços de dados em cloud;
  • Experiência com serviços AWS como Glue, Redshift e Kinesis;
  • Conhecimento em versionamento Git, workflows de repositórios, tags e versionamento semântico;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de automação e scripting como Python, Shell Script e JavaScript;
  • Capacidade analítica para resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para atuação colaborativa entre times multidisciplinares;
  • Perfil hands-on, proativo e orientado à melhoria contínua;
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambientes ágeis e dinâmicos.



Será considerando um diferencial:

  • Certificações AWS, como:
  • AWS Solutions Architect
  • AWS DevOps Engineer
  • AWS Security Specialist
  • Conhecimento em FinOps e otimização de custos cloud;
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a microsserviços;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de alta criticidade.



O que você pode esperar de nós?


  • Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.


O que oferecemos?


  • SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.
  • SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.
  • E muito mais!



+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração



Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.



Faça parte da nossa equipe!



#VempraSONDA

title: Senior Project Manager - SAP MM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Project Manager - SAP MM em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Roles & Responsibilities

Manage daily service delivery for SAP MM and Procurement processes.

Ensure adherence to SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards.

Monitor incident, problem, and change management processes.

Drive continuous service improvements and operational excellence.

SAP MM & Procurement Expertise

Support and manage SAP MM modules including:

Procurement process (PR → PO → GR → Invoice)

Vendor management & master data

Inventory management

Material master & valuation

Act as functional SME for SAP MM-related issues and enhancements.

Collaborate with technical teams for issue resolution and system improvements.

Stakeholder & Client Management

Act as a primary point of contact for business and client stakeholders.

Conduct regular service review meetings.

Provide status reports, insights, and recommendations.

Handle escalations and ensure timely resolution.

Team Management

Lead and mentor a team of SAP MM/Procurement analysts.

Allocate tasks and monitor performance.

Conduct training and skill development initiatives.

Process Improvement & Compliance

Identify process gaps and implement improvements.

Drive automation initiatives in procurement processes.

Ensure compliance with audit and regulatory requirements.

Maintain proper documentation and SOPs.

Transition & Project Support

Support transitions, new implementations, and rollouts.

Participate in requirement gathering and solution design.

Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FI, SD, WM, etc.).


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Country Manager Assistant/Regional Assistant (Brazil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Country Manager Assistant/Regional Assistant (Brazil) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About BingX


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading crypto exchange and Web3 AI company, serving over 40 million users worldwide. Ranked among the top 5 global crypto derivatives platforms and recognized as a pioneer in crypto copy trading, BingX provides a comprehensive suite of AI-driven products and services, including futures, spot trading, copy trading, and TradFi offerings.


BingX empowers users across all experience levels with innovative tools designed to enhance trading performance, confidence, and efficiency. As the principal partner of Chelsea FC since 2024 and the first official crypto exchange partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP in 2026, BingX continues to expand its global presence and strengthen its position as a trusted, intelligent trading platform.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Support the Brazil Country Manager in driving trading volume and user growth
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (Product, UI, Marketing, Branding) to execute local initiatives effectively.
  • Act as the key liaison between HQ and local teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local partners and key stakeholders.
  • Track Brazil market trends and competitor activity to inform strategy.


Requirements


  • Based in Brazil long-term (São Paulo preferred), with 2–5 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Background in Finance, Web3, Fintech, E-commerce, Technology, or International Chinese companies preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and Chinese; and proficiency in English.
  • Strong organizational skills with a proactive, results-oriented mindset.
  • Demonstrates ambition, entrepreneurial spirit, and a strong commitment to career growth in Brazil.


Working at BingX


  • Join a diverse, international team with a global mindset.
  • Grow your career in a fast-moving Web3 and fintech environment.
  • Work on meaningful products that serve millions of users worldwide.
  • Enjoy competitive compensation and flexible work arrangements, depending on role requirements.
  • Follow your local public holiday calendar, with additional benefits based on local policies.

title: Operating Principal
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operating Principal em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Supporting the CEO and senior executives on key company initiatives, Operating Principals are Revolut's general problem solvers.

You'll take ownership of multiple projects and deliver business value through the creation, optimisation, and maintenance of various processes and products.

What you’ll be doing

  • Identifying new growth and revenue opportunities
  • Building and optimising scalable processes to support the company's growth
  • Leading and executing key company initiatives

What you'll need

  • A STEM or other highly quantitative degree from a top-tier university
  • A track record of outstanding achievement in different areas
  • 4+ years of experience in a top-tier investment bank/PE, strategy consultancy, or fast-growing technology company
  • Experience working abroad or as an expat

description:

Somos a Infotec Brasil, uma empresa referência nacional em terceirização de serviços, processos (BPO) e pessoas. Em 2025, celebramos 40 anos de trajetória, atuando com excelência nos setores de Óleo e Gás, Energia, Mineração e Siderurgia.

Nosso propósito é permitir que nossos clientes mantenham o foco em suas estratégias principais, enquanto nós cuidamos das eficiências operacionais. Para isso, buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer a diferença, crescer e inovar conosco.

  • Ambiente colaborativo, ágil e orientado a resultados;

  • Projetos com grandes empresas do cenário nacional e foco em excelência operacional.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This team supports critical financial systems and is responsible for both day-to-day operational support (KTLO) and strategic project work.

Key responsibilities include:

Managing billing support issues and financial system inquiries.

Owning the triage process to ensure incidents, requests, and issues are routed to the appropriate teams.

Performing root cause analysis to identify and resolve underlying system and process issues.

Executing manual corrections and data fixes using internal tools when necessary.

Supporting incident and event management, including troubleshooting and resolution of production issues.

Leading operational initiatives such as the introduction and implementation of annual contracts for enterprise customers.

Designing, documenting, validating, and continuously improving operational processes.

Creating and maintaining process documentation and standard operating procedures.

Operating effectively in ambiguous environments, using judgment to define solutions rather than simply following established processes.



Key Characteristics of the Role

:Strong blend of operations, systems support, process design, and problem-solving

Requires analytical thinking, ownership, and the ability to navigate ambiguity

Focuses on both operational excellence and continuous process improvement across financial systems and billing operations



Requiremen

tsMust-Have Skill

  • s:Strong financial analysis skills with finance and accounting domain expertis
  • e.Deep understanding of billing operations, credit memos, refunds, and the accounts receivable lifecycl
  • e.Ability to confidently discuss and support month-end close activities, reconciliations, AP/AR workflows, financial reporting, and ERP implementations. Experience working with third-party financial and operational system
  • s.Proficiency in writing SQL queries and scripts to extract, analyze, validate, reconcile, and report on business data. Strong data validation, reconciliation, and root cause analysis skill

title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Overview:

As a Gen AI Data Annotation Analyst, you will play a critical role in developing high-quality datasets that power the next generation of Large Language Models (LLMs). You will evaluate, generate, and refine multi-modal data (text, image, or video) to ensure AI outputs are accurate, safe, and culturally resonant for the Portuguese market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Multi-Modal Annotation: Label and categorize high-quality training data across text, image, and video formats with surgical precision.
  • Content Generation: Draft grammatically flawless, creative, and factually accurate text in both Portuguese and English, adapting tone and style for specific project needs.
  • Edge-Case Resolution: Apply logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous data scenarios where guidelines may not explicitly cover a specific nuance.
  • Continuous Feedback: Identify and report bugs within internal annotation tools and suggest workflow optimizations.
  • Cross-Functional Sync: Collaborate with Leads and Project Managers to calibrate on quality benchmarks and project pivots.

System Requirements (Mandatory):

Full set of desktop/Laptop with Windows 11 Pro. Bring a compliant device. Windows 11 Pro (Home editions not allowed) or macOS 12+, 8 GB RAM, 50 GB free disk. Tablets/Chromebooks/phones won’t be accepted.

  • Network: Stable Internet connection, which should have a speed of up to 40MBPS


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
  • Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.


What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
  • Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
  • Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.


Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: Hiring Specialist (Freelance)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Hiring Specialist (Freelance) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Regional Mass Hiring Specialist / BPO Recruiter (Freelance)

Location: Remote, Brazil


Contract Type : Independent Contractor (PJ setup required)


About Thoth AI At Thoth AI, we are building the global data infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI. We require massive amounts of high-quality, localized data (speech, text, image) to train AI models. To achieve this, we are rapidly expanding our crowd-sourcing and freelance network across Latin America.


The Role We need an agile Volume Hiring Specialist and Community Builder . Your primary mission is to build robust, down-to-earth talent pipelines to rapidly fulfill large-scale data collection and annotation projects. If you know how to generate fast candidate traffic and manage micro-vendors in LATAM, this is for you.


What You Will Do

  • High-Volume Sourcing: Execute rapid hiring cycles (e.g., sourcing 50-100 freelance data annotators/speakers within days) using traditional and non-traditional channels.
  • Grassroots Traffic Generation: Dive deep into localized social media (Facebook groups, WhatsApp/Telegram communities), university forums, and regional gig-economy platforms to attract flexible workers.
  • Micro-Vendor Networking: Identify and build partnerships with local BPO agencies, small translation studios, or university student unions to act as our talent sub-nodes.
  • Fast-Paced Screening: Pre-screen large volumes of candidates for language proficiency and project availability, ensuring a seamless handover to our global delivery team.


Who You Are

  • Experience: You have a proven track record in Volume Hiring, BPO Recruitment, or Crowd-sourcing operations (experience with high-turnover/gig-worker recruitment is highly preferred).
  • Mindset: You are a \"hands-on\" executioner, not just a strategist. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-throughput environment and aren't afraid of the grind of mass hiring.
  • Language: Bilingual in English and Portuguese (Spanish is a strong plus for covering LATAM).
  • Prefered Setup: Established as an Independent Contractor with a registered PJ entity in Brazil.
  • Autonomy: Comfortable working remotely and asynchronously with our Global HQ.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Online Ad Rater - Remote Work for German Speakers in Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Seeking a freelance project that will allow you to work from home while making a difference in the world of technology? If you are someone who is passionate and enjoys staying ahead of the tech curve this part-time remote project with flexible working hours might be what you are looking for!


A Day in the Life of a Personalized Internet Ads Assessor:

  • In this role, you will be reviewing online advertisements by rating them on their relevance to the search terms used as well as providing feedback on their language and cultural relevance in order to improve their content, quality, and layout
  • Your ultimate goal will be to contribute towards making internet search and online advertising more relevant and interesting for millions of users, including yourself.



Join our team today and start putting your skills to work for one of the world's leading online advertising platforms while being a part of a supportive community that offers:

  • Access to complimentary mental health support benefits like free EAP and Mindfulness Apps.
  • Dedicated, responsive well-being team proactively offering well-being education each month, as well as quarterly initiatives.



TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.


Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.


Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills, with full professional proficiency in English and Geman
  • Having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Brazil
  • Active use of Gmail, Google+, and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Daily access to a broadband internet connection, a smartphone (Android 4.1, iOS 8 or higher), and a personal computer with antivirus software to work on. You’ll also need a
  • Barcode Scanner application to be installed on your smartphone to complete certain tasks.
  • English CV
  • This is an explicit human evaluation role. Live task rating requires authentic human judgment, perspective, and evaluation


The estimated hourly earnings for this role is 6 USD. Payment is based on completed tasks, with the potential for higher earnings based on productivity.


Assessment

In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take a language assessment and an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Don’t worry, our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience!


Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Hiring Specialist (Freelance)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Hiring Specialist (Freelance) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Regional Mass Hiring Specialist / BPO Recruiter (Freelance)

Location: Remote, Brazil


Contract Type : Independent Contractor (PJ setup required)


About Thoth AI At Thoth AI, we are building the global data infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI. We require massive amounts of high-quality, localized data (speech, text, image) to train AI models. To achieve this, we are rapidly expanding our crowd-sourcing and freelance network across Latin America.


The Role We need an agile Volume Hiring Specialist and Community Builder . Your primary mission is to build robust, down-to-earth talent pipelines to rapidly fulfill large-scale data collection and annotation projects. If you know how to generate fast candidate traffic and manage micro-vendors in LATAM, this is for you.


What You Will Do

  • High-Volume Sourcing: Execute rapid hiring cycles (e.g., sourcing 50-100 freelance data annotators/speakers within days) using traditional and non-traditional channels.
  • Grassroots Traffic Generation: Dive deep into localized social media (Facebook groups, WhatsApp/Telegram communities), university forums, and regional gig-economy platforms to attract flexible workers.
  • Micro-Vendor Networking: Identify and build partnerships with local BPO agencies, small translation studios, or university student unions to act as our talent sub-nodes.
  • Fast-Paced Screening: Pre-screen large volumes of candidates for language proficiency and project availability, ensuring a seamless handover to our global delivery team.


Who You Are

  • Experience: You have a proven track record in Volume Hiring, BPO Recruitment, or Crowd-sourcing operations (experience with high-turnover/gig-worker recruitment is highly preferred).
  • Mindset: You are a \"hands-on\" executioner, not just a strategist. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-throughput environment and aren't afraid of the grind of mass hiring.
  • Language: Bilingual in English and Portuguese (Spanish is a strong plus for covering LATAM).
  • Prefered Setup: Established as an Independent Contractor with a registered PJ entity in Brazil.
  • Autonomy: Comfortable working remotely and asynchronously with our Global HQ.

title: Online Ad Rater - Remote Work for German Speakers in Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Online Ad Rater - Remote Work for German Speakers in Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Seeking a freelance project that will allow you to work from home while making a difference in the world of technology? If you are someone who is passionate and enjoys staying ahead of the tech curve this part-time remote project with flexible working hours might be what you are looking for!


A Day in the Life of a Personalized Internet Ads Assessor:

  • In this role, you will be reviewing online advertisements by rating them on their relevance to the search terms used as well as providing feedback on their language and cultural relevance in order to improve their content, quality, and layout
  • Your ultimate goal will be to contribute towards making internet search and online advertising more relevant and interesting for millions of users, including yourself.



Join our team today and start putting your skills to work for one of the world's leading online advertising platforms while being a part of a supportive community that offers:

  • Access to complimentary mental health support benefits like free EAP and Mindfulness Apps.
  • Dedicated, responsive well-being team proactively offering well-being education each month, as well as quarterly initiatives.



TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.


Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.


Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills, with full professional proficiency in English and Geman
  • Having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Brazil
  • Active use of Gmail, Google+, and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Daily access to a broadband internet connection, a smartphone (Android 4.1, iOS 8 or higher), and a personal computer with antivirus software to work on. You’ll also need a
  • Barcode Scanner application to be installed on your smartphone to complete certain tasks.
  • English CV
  • This is an explicit human evaluation role. Live task rating requires authentic human judgment, perspective, and evaluation


The estimated hourly earnings for this role is 6 USD. Payment is based on completed tasks, with the potential for higher earnings based on productivity.


Assessment

In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take a language assessment and an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Don’t worry, our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience!


Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Strategist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.


We’re looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You’ll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale.


Responsibilities

Creative Strategy

  • Contribute to the development of creative strategy for paid social, grounded in direct-response principles
  • Translate performance data, customer research, and competitive insights into effective copy frameworks and angles
  • Support the creation of ad concepts and scalable creative approaches
  • Participate in brainstorming and help shape a testing roadmap of angles, messages, and formats based on clear hypotheses
  • Help maintain creative standards to ensure consistent brand voice and persuasive quality across ads, landing pages, and funnels


Performance & Media Buying Integration

  • Use platform learnings and audience behavior to shape creative testing and copy direction.
  • Build feedback loops so creative evolves weekly based on performance data across ads


AI & Creative Innovation

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate creative research and performance testing.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs and prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).


Qualifications

  • Experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or e-commerce marketing.
  • Hands-on experience with direct-response copywriting
  • Direct experience with women’s wellness, supplements, or health-related products strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs/prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (e.g., scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).
  • Strong portfolio of paid social creative with proven ROI.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Working hours

  • 6am - 2pm EST (Monday - Friday)
  • Fully-remote


Compensation

  • $3,500 to $5,000/month


If you think you might be a good fit, please apply.
